notes.title: Bug fixing: Version 1.0.6 is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

It's been over a month since our previous update, and it's because we have released the Nintendo Switch version in the meantime! Yay! It doesn't mean that we have slacked off on the PC version, but we have had to fix issues on both platforms, so we just packed everything together. Here is the list of fixes brought by this 1.0.6 update:


 Firefly achievement is now fixed;
 Fixed issues with minions on level 7, The Forgotten City, and level 9, the Underground Market, that could see Pierre stuck with no possibility to move;
 fixed dialogue issues and freezes in some levels.


If after updating to version 1.0.6 (version number appears on the lower right corner of your screen when launching the game), you still encounter any of those bugs, please let us know in the comments here or on our Discord

Issue Feedback
When reporting any issue, please let us know:

 Your system specs (RAM, CPU, GPU, OS + architecture (32 or 64 bits), and any additional information that you think is relevant)
 What you were doing when the bug happened (launched a new game, accessing a level already played, etc.)
 Any other information that you think is relevant


See you soon in Opera City!

notes.title: Bug fixing: Version 1.0.4 is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

It has been a week since the last update, and it is because we have been working on the remaining bugs in the game that seem to plague a few players here and there, notably the cage in the Haunted Mansion level. We are happy to say that it has finally been fixed, and you should now be able to reopen the cage upon entering it. Yay!
Please find the list of fixes below:


 fix some chests that would keep their collected state after creating a new clean save;
 fix achievements progression;
 fix a situation where some players would not be able to re-open the cage in the Haunted Mansion level.


If after updating to version 1.0.4 (version number appears on the lower right corner of your screen when launching the game), you still encounter any of those bugs, please let us know in the comments here or on our Discord

 fix "Unmazed" achievement not unlocking;

notes.title: Bug fixing: Version 1.0.2 is up!
Bug fixing: Version 1.0.1 is up!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective launched yesterday and we are super happy and proud to see so many of you enjoyed the game so far!

Alas, even after extensive testing (until the very last minute actually), some players have encountered a few bugs that hindered their enjoyment of the game. However, our little hands have been working hard yesterday in order to fix some of the most recurring issues: 


 fix pause screen issues
 fix grabbing the kite in level 4
 cinematic videos volume is now linked to SFX volume in options
 fix an issue where you could stay stuck in a "one way" minion


If after updating to version 1.0.1 (version number appears on the lower right corner of your screen when launching the game), you still encounter any of those bugs, please let us know in the Steam Hub or on our Discord

Issue Feedback
When reporting any issue, please let us know:


 Your system specs (RAM, CPU, GPU, OS + architecture (32 or 64 bits), and any additional information that you think is relevant)
 What you were doing when the bug happened (launched a new game, accessing a level already played, etc.)
 Any other information that you think is relevant


We hope this fixes will help you enjoy your stay in Opera City more!

notes.title: Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective Out Now on Steam!
notes.content:
This is it, folks!

Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective is officially out right now, after 3 years of development, hundred of hours poured in making animations, art, dialogues, music, programming, etc.

We hope you'll enjoy following Pierre and Carmen's adventures throughout Opera City.
We hope you'll love getting lost in the different mazes, by yourself or with your loved ones.
We hope you'll find all the hidden objects, treasures and references.

But, most of all, we hope you'll have an amazing time playing Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective!

Here is our official trailer to celebrate the release!

[previewyoutube=fXz1xidDWW8;full][/previewyoutube]

And remember, Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective is:


 10 levels adapted from the original double-page spread illustrations from IC4Design
 Over 100 hidden objects
 Over 500 interactions
 MILLIONS of lines of dialogues (okay, maybe not *millions*, but a good amount nonetheless)
 Hours of fun


See you soon in Opera City!

notes.title: Come discover Labyrinth City with the developers!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow detectives!

As you already know, this week is the Steam Next Fest, and Labyrinth City will participate! You will be able to play the demo of the game for a whole week before it releases, so don’t hesitate to spread the good news around you!

To celebrate this, we cordially invite you to join us in one of the two streams that we have set up:

 June 19 at 10pm (GMT +8)
 June 21 at 6pm (GMT +8)


To make things a little more interesting, we also have a small speedrun contest brewing. Post a video of you completing the demo at 100% (meaning, finding ALL hidden objects) and tag us on Facebook, Twitter or Discord to enter the contest! The fastest player to finish the demo will receive a redeem code for Steam!

And if you liked the game, it will be available starting June 22 at a discounted price for a limited time!

Links:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Labyrinth-City-Pierre-the-Maze-Detective-101909508380555
Twitter: https://twitter.com/city_labyrinth
Discord: https://discord.gg/HD9ZxWy7Ud

notes.title: Labyrinth City participates in MGN online festival on May 31!
notes.content:
Hello there, fellow detectives!

We are happy to announce the participation of Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective in the MGN online Indie Game Festival, jointly held by Steam and ACFUN on May 31 at 8pm (GMT +8). This festival is a great opportunity to introduce many indie games to Chinese players, and we are not about to pass this opportunity!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38763391/fa3af54eb38fd0753a3f70b1e4e2b113ce3ea60e.jpg

Whether you are a connoisseur of indie games who is interested in this edition of MGN or one of our long-time detective fans, don’t miss the stream happening here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/mgn and https://live.acfun.cn/live/934542

Festival schedule:

 May 31 at 7.30pm (GMT +8): Festival warm-up
 May 31 at 8pm (GMT +8): Indie Game Festival
 May 31 at 10pm (GMT +8): Indie Game Festival’s demo showcase


If you cannot make it in time for the stream, don’t worry: The VOD will be available on ACFUN and YouTube.
